data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 防波堤上的西瓜清甜
data.description: 蔚蓝的海浪一下下拍打着消波块。白羽盘腿坐在防波堤边缘，小口啃着冰镇过的红壤西瓜。看见有人走近，她警惕地鼓起腮帮，却还是递出了一片切好的瓜。
data.location: concrete ocean breakwater embankment against sparkling turquoise sea and puffy cumulus clouds
data.action: sitting cross-legged on seawall, eating a chilled slice of watermelon, turning with guarded yet bashful red eyes
data.lighting: dazzling seaside summer sun illuminating pure white hair and ocean foam
data.mood: pristine island youth, nostalgic Key summer atmosphere, adorable tsundere gap moe
data.promptProse: Perched on a seaside seawall under summer clouds, white-haired Shiroha eats watermelon, casting a shy tsundere glance with crimson eyes.
data.animaCaption: Shiroha Naruse eating fresh watermelon on a coastal breakwater under sunny skies.
